description: Connected Scatter Plot Chart for Effective Project Management Connected Scatter Plot by Office Solution The Connected Scatter Plot chart by Office Solution is a specialized type of dot chart used in statistical analysis to compare data based on the Legend by providing the corresponding X and Y data. In this chart, each dot is scattered according to the x and y data, and a connection is made based on the “Legend.” This visualization technique helps to find the common connection and interconnection of the x and y data according to the Legend. By pressing a single line, other lines hide. X and Y data must be numeric, while the Legend can be any data type, as the connection is made only based on the Legend. The X-Y data are only scattered. Key Benefits Basic Features: Visual Clarity: Easily distinguish between various Legends by connection lines and their colors, providing an immediate visual representation of the scattered data. Dropdown: This chart supports a dropdown feature that helps the user to select particular data by choosing an option from the dropdown. Make sure more than one data point is added. The dropdown feature also toggles between the various charts combined with this chart. Size: The chart is resizable and dynamic in nature, adjusting according to the size as well as dot size and line size (stroke width). Dynamic Data Handling: Capable of managing large datasets…
